searchText: My understanding is that only the Kiln v2 engine API is required. We're not planning to support anything else in LH. That would include jwt authentication which is different to kiln v1 + the renaming PR. Although I'm not sure it would matter if I sent auth when it wasn't required. I understand that Kiln v2 also allows for un-authenticated comms. I don't see a whole lot of value on blocking the next round of testnets since some clients haven't implemented a JWT yet. I see very little risk that clients get stuck on that task and delay the merge. On a separate topic, we've implemented the rename in LH but now we fail the `ssz_static` tests since there's some YAML using `random` rather than `prev_randao`. I can probably shim around this, but I'm wondering if there's an intention to cut a new set of consensus test vectors? (cc the testing crew: <@!291925846556540928>, <@!415109946682769408>) This is it Essentially, we want to do v2. V2 doesn't yet deprecate un-auth to allow for people still getting up to speed here. The rest is v2. Deprecate kintsugi and deprecate kiln v1 Will do tmw Forgot this would ripple into subsets of testing It's pretty much Do v2. But note the following if still getting up to speed * Support renaming now, no matter what * Try to support auth asap but unauth port is still open * If you don't support the status ping, everything will still work but you'll get a bunch of errors on the other side before genesis if they support it Right I guess that makes sense. Sorry to be grumpy about this but we go to a lot of effort to have specs and milestones so if we can just follow them it makes everything a lot easier to understand for everyone. In this case it sounds like kiln v2 is more forgiving than I had in mind because of the unauth port still being around. Really didn't want auth to block everything else in testing. Is the idea And the ping method isn't critical for functionality Naming will break comms though Agree though. Best to just do v2 And it be v2 Almost all clients are planning on being fully v2 iiuc Yep cool. I'm just trying to keep us "honest" and particularly keep communication of progress clear because it's already hard enough for people to understand how close we are to the merge so muddying the water really doesn't help. And we're at the pointy end of things where the details do matter and will take some time to wrap up - by themselves they don't cause delays but they do cause knock on effects. I'll put the grumpy troll away again for a bit. 🙂 mmhmm.. sure you will... 🙂 FWIW, I like grumpy troll Adrian, and generally agree with them. Does that make me a grumpy troll to? If so I accept it as a badge of honor. My `merge-kiln-v2` branch should ™️ have the full v2 with JWT, renaming, exchangeTransitionConfig, auth and unauthenticated ports. I didn't have the time to properly test it yet, so there might be some 🐛 there Yeah already found three Was one of them related to it saying: ``` WARN [02-25|20:41:31.235] Served engine_newPayloadV1 conn=127.0.0.1:62779 reqid=122 duration="181.916µs" err="invalid argument 0: missing required field 'random' for ExecutableDataV1" ``` ? It should be `prevRandao` now from what I understand (but <@!504202741933932544> has been doing the actual work on that) I’m going to give it a try later today <tbenr> Btw make sure you're using --Xee-version kilnv2 Hmm not really, I missed the renaming for the parameter. Should work now Okay I had another issue, *now* it should work ™️ Can confirm `merge-kiln-v2` is good with me. Tested local interop with Prysm `merge-kiln-v2` is also passing LH integration tests
